SELECT component_name, COUNT(*) AS scan_count
FROM status_logs
GROUP BY component_name
ORDER BY scan_count DESC
LIMIT 3

results.question: What is the average number of status changes per component?
results.generated: SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM status_logs GROUP BY component_id) t

results.question: What is the longest time a component waited between two status changes?
results.generated:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY component_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS gap
  FROM status_logs
)
SELECT MAX(gap) AS longest_wait
FROM ordered

results.question: What is the average time between consecutive status changes at each workstation?
results.generated:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT workstation_name, timestamp,
         timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY workstation_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS gap
  FROM status_logs
)
SELECT workstation_name, AVG(gap) AS avg_time
FROM ordered
WHERE gap IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY workstation_name
LIMIT 100
